title: Term schedules
intro: Read the recorded terms and election schedule for a selected place.
choose_help: Open any place and choose Term schedules beside its legislature and maps. Your residence does not restrict which place you can view.
no_legislature: No legislature is recorded for this place.
clock_help: The scheduled date comes from the armed election clock. Settings describe the configured interval; they do not replace the recorded dates of a running term.
select_clock: Select a legislature to read its recorded term and election schedule.
elected_scope: Serving terms linked to the selected legislature in this place.
place_elected_scope: Serving elected terms recorded in this exact place. Constituent places have their own records.
appointed_scope: Serving appointments recorded in this exact place. These use their own appointment dates.
appointment_settings: Configured appointment lengths: civil {civil} years; judicial {judicial} years. Each row shows its actual recorded expiry.
no_terms: No active terms are recorded in this scope.
refusal_scope: These entries are linked to this place in the audit record. Entries without a recorded place cannot be associated with this view.
no_refusals: No clock refusals linked to this place are recorded.
about: This page is read-only. Elected replacements inherit the existing term expiry. Officials cannot skip, delay, reschedule, or extend an elected term through this page.
